# `box`

Helper: `box(tone, ...kids)`, `box({ tone, title }, ...kids)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap (rich notice container) · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaNotice` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Callout with a left-aligned title (small 600) and children such as fields, badges and buttons.

## Variants

- Tone: info, warning, danger, success, neutral

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

info/warning/danger/success with -soft and -line, tile, radius-tile

## Do

- Use when a notice must contain controls

## Don't

- Do not use for plain text (notice)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Padding 12/14.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Container. Callout with children (fields, badges, buttons), e.g. a notice that holds a slider
